attributes.title: ANPA 2027 Annual Conference
attributes.series: Arkansas Nurse Practitioner Association Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
Arkansas NPs meet at the Statehouse Convention Center in Little Rock from Thursday afternoon, April 1, through Saturday, April 3, 2027. The extra Thursday preconference is the part to look at if you prescribe in midlife care: it covers menopause hormone therapy, with an evening reception after it.

Every full and Friday-Saturday ticket includes the recorded sessions afterward, which helps if you must leave early. ANPA says contact-hour totals, pharmacology hours and accreditation details are not published yet, so check them before you count this toward a renewal. Workshops cost extra and have limited space. The fees shown are for Friday and Saturday; adding the Thursday preconference raises each by $100.
